reason: Fresh successor authorization for the post-retirement Product reachability P1 batch after PR #611 exposed immutable authorization-path introduction ambiguity. The predecessor Product diagnosis is still valid in substance, but its implementation authority is unusable because the predecessor authorization repository path was introduced once by accidental single-parent commit e5ddb9ca6a722b0c85cbea9a2fb8757957ea206d, deleted by forward-only recovery 62f3935605dac9ab96f76f80cee88943dfae1a2c, then reintroduced by ordinary authorization merge 2dbdc148bab0c3bf51adcd64e38077e48a567ca2. The trusted evaluator intentionally requires exactly one path introduction and therefore rejects that lineage. This successor uses a never-before-used authorization path and a new implementation branch, does not formally supersede the invalid predecessor because that target cannot form an effective delegated-governance record, and recreates the one-path failure-first diagnostic from fresh trusted main before any production scope is authorized. The causal Product root remains: active Element Product reachability for data protection/portable recovery, Adaptive Local/local auxiliary lifecycle, Model Brain/LiteLLM runtime truth, and executable WP0/WP2 acceptance that must stop treating retired frontend/ as Product authority. Existing backend/runtime authorities remain PRESERVE. No production path is authorized by this proposal.

invalidPredecessor.reasonFormalSupersessionOmitted: The generic evaluator requires the superseded target to resolve to an effective record. The predecessor cannot resolve because its authorization path has more than one first-parent introduction; adding a supersession edge would poison the successor graph as well.
invalidPredecessor.reuseRule: Do not continue, merge, rebase, amend or force-update PR #611. Recreate diagnostic intent only on this fresh successor lineage.

digestCanonicalization.pathNormalization: Require exact normalized repository-relative paths, remove duplicates, then sort with JavaScript default Array.prototype.sort().
digestCanonicalization.canonicalText: Join the normalized sorted unique path list with LF and append exactly one trailing LF before hashing.

expectedFailures: The sole active Element Product has no user-reachable data-protection surface for backup verification, staged/cancelled restore, restore history, and encrypted portable backup import/export/verify/restore even though existing backend and Electron authorities are real.

Adaptive Local LLM / local auxiliary model lifecycle is still accepted as user-facing through retired frontend/r32-system-center.js and frontend/js/r32-ai-workbench-runtime.js while the active Element Product has no equivalent adaptive-local consumer.

Core Model Brain UI acceptance still proves Model Brain/LiteLLM visibility, eligibility, health and execution evidence using retired frontend/index.html, AI Workbench and System Center rather than the active Element Product.
tools/wp2/command-path-inventory.js still derives rendererLocations from retired frontend/ only, so executable reachability evidence can remain GREEN without proving the sole active Element Product.
Existing WP0 Adaptive Local and Model Brain UI acceptance contracts still reference retired frontend Product surfaces and must be migrated rather than weakened.

No production path, dependency, workflow, routing policy, database migration, release/publish or PR #538 mutation is authorized by this proposal.
